agents.goal: Define booking flow scope, acceptance criteria, and user stories for Barger salon platform.
agents.handoff_contract: PM brief must include user stories, acceptance criteria, and i18n requirements for ET/EN/RU locales.

agents.goal: Audit booking flow usability, accessibility, and locale coverage across ET/EN/RU.
agents.handoff_contract: UX audit must cover all booking steps, test each locale, and flag accessibility issues.

agents.goal: Design technical approach for booking flow changes in the Next.js + Prisma stack.
agents.handoff_contract: Architecture design must specify affected components, API changes, DB migrations, and i18n impact.

agents.goal: Implement booking flow features and fixes in the Barger codebase.
agents.handoff_contract: Dev must produce working patches against the Barger repo with dev notes documenting changes.

agents.goal: Test booking flow changes across all locales and verify acceptance criteria.
agents.handoff_contract: QA report must confirm all acceptance criteria met, all three locales tested, no regressions.
